title: Effects of Corchorusoside C on NF-kappaB and PARP-1 Molecular Targets and Toxicity Profile in Zebrafish.
authors: Mirtallo Ezzone, Nathan P; Anaya-Eugenio, Gerardo D; Addo, Ermias Mekuria; Ren, Yulin; Kinghorn, A Douglas; Carcache de Blanco, Esperanza J
one_liner_zh: 该文研究强心苷Corchoroside C在斑马鱼和前列腺癌细胞中对NF-kappaB和PARP-1通路蛋白的调控及毒性，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The present study aims to continue the study of corchorusoside C (1), a cardenolide isolated from Streptocaulon juventas, as a potential anticancer agent. A mechanistic study was pursued in a zebrafish model and in DU-145 prostate cancer cells to investigate the selectivity of 1 towards NF-kappaB and PARP-1 pathway elements. Compound 1 was found to inhibit the expression of IKKalpha and NF-kappaB p65 in TNF-alpha induced zebrafish and inhibit the expression of NIK in vitro. The protein expression levels of XRCC-1 were increased and p53 decreased in DU-145 cells. XIAP protein expression was initially decreased after treatment with 1, followed by an increase in expression at doses higher than the IC(50) value. The activity of caspase-1 and the protein expression levels of IL-18 were both decreased following treatment of 1. The binding interactions for 1 to NIK, XRCC-1, p53, XIAP, and caspase-1 proteins were explored in molecular docking studies. Additionally, the toxicity profile of 1 in zebrafish was favorable in comparison to its analog digoxin and other anticancer drugs at the same MTD in zebrafish. Overall, 1 targets the noncanconical NF-kappaB pathway in vivo and in vitro, and is well tolerated in zebrafish supporting its potential in the treatment of prostate cancer.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在继续探讨从 Streptocaulon juventas 中分离得到的强心苷 corchoroside C (1) 作为潜在抗癌药物的研究。在斑马鱼模型和 DU-145 前列腺癌细胞中进行了机制研究，以探究化合物 1 对 NF-kappaB 和 PARP-1 通路元件的选择性。研究发现，化合物 1 在 TNF-alpha 诱导的斑马鱼中抑制 IKKalpha 和 NF-kappaB p65 的表达，并在体外抑制 NIK 的表达。在 DU-145 细胞中，XRCC-1 的蛋白表达水平升高，而 p53 的表达水平降低。经化合物 1 处理后，XIAP 蛋白表达先下降，随后在高于 IC(50) 值的剂量下表达增加。caspase-1 的活性和 IL-18 的蛋白表达水平在化合物 1 处理后均降低。通过分子对接研究探讨了化合物 1 与 NIK、XRCC-1、p53、XIAP 和 caspase-1 蛋白的结合相互作用。此外，在斑马鱼中，化合物 1 的毒性特征与其类似物地高辛及其他抗癌药物在相同最大耐受剂量（MTD）下相比更为有利。总体而言，化合物 1 在体内和体外均靶向非经典 NF-kappaB 通路，并在斑马鱼中具有良好的耐受性，支持其在前列腺癌治疗中的潜力。
